data.one_liner: Integration of OpenAI API using Flutter framework, ChatGPT and more
data.what_it_does: Integrates the OpenAI API into Flutter applications. It supports completions, streams, image generation, and transcriptions.
use_when: You need to integrate OpenAI ChatGPT or completions in a Flutter app
You want support for streaming responses from OpenAI models
avoid_when: You are using on-device models instead of hosted cloud APIs
You require backend features outside of OpenAI's API scope
strengths: Includes support for multiple models including custom fine-tuned ones and image generation endpoints
weaknesses: Not documented beyond basic API usage in README
data.setup_notes: Requires creating an OpenAI account and obtaining an API key.

alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative AI integration via Firebase services.

alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative for running local models instead of OpenAI.
